notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
Rune Seed: attacks now deal 2 Poison Damage as well as apply 1 stack of Dormant Poison.
Rune Spikes: Physical damage increased from 20%/35%/50% > 2+20%/4+35%/6+50%.
Rune Spikes: Rune Essence cost increased from 15/30/45 > 21/42/63.
Burn Damage increased from % of Fire Damage > 1+% of Fire Damage.
Burst of Light: Light Damage bonus reduced from 3/6/10 > 1/3/5.
Burst of Light: base damage increased from 0/0/0 > 1/3/6.
Lily's Chosen: Light Damage bonus reduced from 3/5 > 1/3

[b]Fixed[/b]
Fixed Crush upgrades giving +1 Physical Damage instead of +2.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
-The details for Global Damage % are now more clearly explained in terms of its effects.
-Towers will remember the last selected upgrade type and will default to that upgrade type the next time they are selected.
-Chaos Rift damage increased from 12-28 > 12-36

[b]Fixed[/b]
-Magic Dust cost display for Ancient Magic spell upgrades.
-Visual glitch on Meteor & Shadow Bolt trails.
-Visual glitch on Forgotten Soul's trail.
-Visual glitch on Champion of Light's attack effect.
-Issue with some quests resetting progress when closing the game.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Added option to reset your progress.
Navigate to settings in the main menu, use the 'trash' button in the top left of the settings panel.

notes.title: Major Update 1.2.0 - Quests and More!
notes.content:
[b]Introducing Quests	[/b]
Introducing Quests! The spirit of a Priest of Lily requires your assistance in cleansing and reclaiming the temple.	
Complete a wide variety of quests to earn new and unique rewards!	

[b]4 New Maps	[/b]
Treasury	
Storage Room	
Gravekeeper's Passage	
The Necromancer's Tomb
	
[b]3 New Relics	[/b]
Everlasting Rune - Reduces the Rune Essence cost of Towers for each Tower build.	
Divine Amulet - Occasionally execute low Health enemies, doing so grants XP to all Towers.	
Ring of the Elements - All enemies lose Fire, Frost, and Lightning Resistance.	
	
[b]3 New Runes	[/b]
Crystal Shards - Grow Crystal Shards near the tower that seek out enemies and cause Light Damage.	
Primal Resonance - Casting a Spell temporarily increases Spell Power.	
Chaos Rift - Open a Chaos Rift, summoning Shadow Bolts that cause Chaos Damage.	
	
[b]8 New Spells	[/b]
Rune Seed - Plant a Rune Seed that grows over time, and will attack and poison enemies when fully grown.	
Cleanse - Cleanses all corpses in the target area, after a short delay, call down Fallen Angel causing Light Damage in a large area.	
Holy Light - Restore a small amount of Lives.	
Iceblast - Blast the target location with Frost Damage.	
Stormblast - Blast the target location with Lightning Damage.	
Crush - Crush enemies at the target location, dealing Physical Damage. Some objects can be damaged by Crush.	
Ancient Ritual - Perform an Ancient Ritual, the effects of which are largely unknown.	
Lights Fury - Call forth the light of Lily to temporarily enhance all towers with extra Light Damage and Attack Speed.	
	
[b]Other	[/b]
Relics & Magic Dust added to achievement rewards.	
13 new Achievements.	
	
[b]Changes	[/b]
Gravekeeper - Physical Resistance increased from 0 > 20%	
Bone Moth -  Physical Resistance increased from 0 > 10%	
Rat King - Lightning Resistance increased from 10 > 25%	
Frozen Spirit - Lightning Resistance increased from 10 > 25%	
Multishot - Damage reduction increased from -15%/-30% > -20%/-40%	
Multishot - Rune Essence cost increased from 40/80 > 50/100	
Multishot - Upgrade Point cost increased from 3 > 4	
Bounce - Damage reduction increased from -15%/-30% > -20%/-40%	
Bounce - Rune Essence cost increased from 40/80 > 50/100	
Bounce - Upgrade Point cost increased from 3 > 4	
Dying Banshee's heal for more	
Hard, Chaos, Nightmare difficulty increased	

[b]Fixed[/b]	
Missing details for Magic Missiles	
Ancient Magic spell cooldowns starting at 0 seconds.	
missing cost info on spell upgrades	

Have fun!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
-Level selection reworked to now show the layout of the temple.
-Fixed issue with end-game display showing victory on defeat.
-Fixed enemy animations in the enemy info panel scaling with game speed.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
-Added Relics; Powerful objects said to be of great importance to the goddess Lily.		
Only one Relic can be held at a time, and the Relic is consumed upon use,		
granting powerful benefits or alterations.	
-Added enemy Rune Essence value to the enemy detail panel.
-Added descriptions for the function of each room within the temple		
-Minor changes made to most maps

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
-Added upgrades to Ancient Magic spells to increase their power
-New resource: Magic Dust - used to upgrade Ancient Magic spells, and can be obtained from Rune Coffers.
-Added end-wave resources gained information to in-game resource displays.
-Added more stats to end-game screen.
-Added option to lock camera controls to a set axis, rather than based on current view.
-Fixed issue with Level 14 not unlocking
-Fixed Ice Crash not slowing enemies
-Barrier Mana cost increased from 20 > 75
-Mystery Plague Mana cost increased from 30 > 45
-Mystery Plague Damage reduced from 60 > 40
-Chain Lightning base number of jumps reduced from 8 > 6
-Max lives increased to 1000

notes.title: Small Update

-New Map: Rune Control Room	
-New Upgrades: Burning Orbs, Freezing Orbs, Shocking Orbs can be found in Rune Coffers.	
-Added icons for enemy displays	
-Fixed issue with tower 'close to exit' and 'far from exit' targeting modes	
-Fixed issue with light damage not displaying in details	
-Fixed targeting range on Enchanted Blade	
-Fixed issue with Ray of Light.
